No one whose neighbour is unsafe from him enters Paradise; a believer treats his neighbour well, honours his guest, and speaks good or keeps silent.
No one should stop his neighbour from fixing a beam in his wall, and Abu Huraira rebuked those who turned away from this.
Gabriel urged kindness to neighbours on the Prophet so often he thought they would be made heirs, and he told Abu Dharr to add water to his broth for neighbours.
